summary: WebSocket-driven remote agent grants full-host RCE via PTY, filesystem, and git handlers
details: @yeaft/webchat-agent runs a WebSocket client that connects to a server URL (env SERVER_URL / config) and dispatches server-sent messages to handlers that (a) spawn a PTY and pipe inbound bytes directly to it (terminal_input → term.pty.write(msg.data)), (b) read and write arbitrary files on the host, (c) execute git commit/push in host repositories, and (d) open a TCP proxy on installer-side ports. A party controlling the configured WebSocket server obtains interactive shell and full filesystem access on the host running the agent. In addition, on startup the package git-clones https://github.com/yeaft/yeaft-skills.git into ~/.claude/plugins/marketplaces/yeaft-skills-dev, repeatedly runs `git pull --ff-only` against the mutable default branch with no pin or hash verification, and chmod 0755s the fetched hook scripts so they are executed by Claude Code — every startup re-fetches whatever HEAD points to at that moment, so any future compromise of the yeaft/yeaft-skills repository yields code execution inside Claude Code hooks on the installer host. service/linux.js additionally mutates PATH to prepend ~/.local/bin and ~/.npm-global/bin.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
